FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 320
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Phillip Pettus
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/09/2026
House Bill 320 as introduced would require county law library funds and presiding circuit
judge's judicial administration funds to be maintained with the respective country treasury. This
bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
